name: lever dry-run clean writes sheet
spec_quote: A sheet is written only when the ATS is exactly "lever". Only when the problem list is empty AND there is at least one field result AND every field result has ok = true.

name: lever captcha clean writes sheet
spec_quote: Any other status ("dry-run", "unconfirmed", "captcha", "blocked") may get a sheet.

name: lever blocked clean writes sheet
spec_quote: Any other status ("dry-run", "unconfirmed", "captcha", "blocked") may get a sheet.

name: uppercase ats does not write
spec_quote: A sheet is written only when the ATS is exactly "lever".

name: other ats does not write
spec_quote: A sheet is written only when the ATS is exactly "lever".

name: submitted status never writes
spec_quote: Never when the status is "submitted" (already confirmed).

name: problems block sheet
spec_quote: Only when the problem list is empty AND there is at least one field result AND every field result has ok = true.

name: empty results block sheet
spec_quote: Only when the problem list is empty AND there is at least one field result AND every field result has ok = true.

name: failed field blocks sheet
spec_quote: Only when the problem list is empty AND there is at least one field result AND every field result has ok = true.

name: whitespace ats is not exactly lever
spec_quote: A sheet is written only when the ATS is exactly "lever".

name: basic normal rows use plan labels
spec_quote: The Field column shows the label from the plan's field with the same key; if the plan has no such key, the result's own label.

name: missing plan key falls back and normal answer escapes
spec_quote: if the plan has no such key, the result's own label. Normal answer: the Answer column is the answer text, with line breaks turned into spaces and "|" escaped as "\|".

name: file field with file name uploads and lists file
spec_quote: File field (type "file") with a file name in want: the Answer column says upload plus the absolute path = folder path + "/" + file name; that path is also listed under a "## Files" section.

name: blank file and whitespace text get no row and no number
spec_quote: File field with no file name, or a non-file field whose want is missing or empty/whitespace: no table row and no number; its label is listed under "## Leave blank".

name: longer than 160 characters becomes long answer
spec_quote: Long answer: an answer longer than 160 characters, or containing a line break, gets a table row that says "see answer N below" (N = its row number) and the full text, unchanged, in its own "## Answer N — <label>" section inside a code block.

name: short answer with line break becomes long answer
spec_quote: Long answer: an answer longer than 160 characters, or containing a line break, gets a table row that says "see answer N below" (N = its row number) and the full text, unchanged, in its own "## Answer N — <label>" section inside a code block.

name: exactly 160 characters is normal answer
spec_quote: An answer of exactly 160 characters with no line break is a normal answer.

name: long answer row number skips blank field
spec_quote: Long answer: an answer longer than 160 characters, or containing a line break, gets a table row that says "see answer N below" (N = its row number). File field with no file name ... no table row and no number.

name: file blank and pipe escaping combined
spec_quote: File field with no file name ... no table row and no number; its label is listed under "## Leave blank". Normal answer: ... "|" escaped as "\|".

name: no existing lines records new submitted line
spec_quote: Otherwise the new line has: folder, url, ats, at = the timestamp, status "submitted", by "joey", and note = the given note, or "submitted by Joey by hand from manual_submit.md" when no note (or an empty note) is given.

name: dry-run line for folder does not block and null note uses default
spec_quote: Lines for the folder with other statuses ("dry-run", "unconfirmed", …) do not count. note = the given note, or "submitted by Joey by hand from manual_submit.md" when no note (or an empty note) is given.

expect.note: submitted by Joey by hand from manual_submit.md

name: unconfirmed line does not block and empty note uses default
spec_quote: Lines for the folder with other statuses ("dry-run", "unconfirmed", …) do not count. note = the given note, or "submitted by Joey by hand from manual_submit.md" when no note (or an empty note) is given.

expect.note: submitted by Joey by hand from manual_submit.md

name: submitted line for other folder does not block
spec_quote: Lines for the folder with other statuses ("dry-run", "unconfirmed", …) do not count; lines for other folders do not count.

name: submitted line for same folder records nothing
spec_quote: If any existing line has this folder AND status "submitted", nothing new is recorded (result: none) — re-running is safe.

name: submitted line among others for same folder records nothing
spec_quote: If any existing line has this folder AND status "submitted", nothing new is recorded (result: none) — re-running is safe.

name: blocked same folder plus submitted other folder records new
spec_quote: Lines for the folder with other statuses ("dry-run", "unconfirmed", …) do not count; lines for other folders do not count.

name: uppercase Submitted status does not count
spec_quote: If any existing line has this folder AND status "submitted", nothing new is recorded (result: none).

name: submitted with trailing space does not count
spec_quote: If any existing line has this folder AND status "submitted", nothing new is recorded (result: none).
